topic: Al-Biruni (973-1050 CE) estimated the size of the Earth using a mountain, the horizon and simple geometry, and his answer was very close to the real value.

episode.title: Al-Biruni: Pahaar Se Zameen Ki Pemaish!

shots.narration: پورا چکر لگائے بغیر زمین کا سائز کیسے پتا چلے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D animated library with brass instruments and blank closed manuscripts; a glowing unlabelled Earth floats above a table, no text anywhere.
shots.action: Hamza spreads his arms around the enormous floating Earth.
shots.mood: Friendly wonder, warm amber light and soft blue planetary glow.

shots.narration: نوری نے حمزہ کو البیرونی کی تحقیق دکھائی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm library opening into a luminous historical projection of a rocky mountain; Al-Biruni appears only as a small respectful cartoon figure seen from behind, no writing.
shots.action: Noori projects the mountain scene across the library.

shots.narration: [surprised] اتنی بڑی زمین، اور بس ایک پہاڑ؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, immersive projected mountain landscape with a broad distant horizon, family-film 3D style, no text.
shots.action: Hamza tilts his head toward the towering summit.

shots.narration: زمین اتنی بڑی ہے کہ اس کا خم چھپ جاتا ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, educational projection showing Hamza beside a tiny patch of ground on a huge curved Earth, unlabelled and without markings.
shots.action: The projected view pulls back from flat-looking ground to reveal Earth's curve.
shots.mood: Clear visual discovery, soft blue and green light.

shots.narration: البیرونی نے پہلے پہاڑ کی اونچائی معلوم کی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, projected mountain profile with a distant rear-view historical scholar at its base; an unlabelled luminous triangle connects the ground and summit, no numbers or letters.
shots.action: Noori traces a glowing vertical line from the mountain's base to its summit.
shots.mood: Focused curiosity, warm stone and brass tones.

shots.narration: [excited] پھر چوٹی سے دور افق کو دیکھا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, mountain summit above a wide unobstructed horizon; Al-Biruni is a small respectful rear-view cartoon figure beside a plain brass sighting instrument, no text.
shots.action: The distant scholar sights toward the horizon through the brass instrument.
shots.mood: Quiet concentration, clear sky and gentle sunlight.

shots.narration: جہاں زمین آسمان سے ملتی لگے، وہ افق ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Hamza within Noori's projected summit view, with a crisp distant boundary between land and sky, no labels.
shots.action: Hamza points toward the distant horizon.

shots.narration: انہوں نے دیکھا، افق سیدھی نظر سے کتنا نیچے ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, projected side-view diagram at the summit; one unlabelled horizontal ray and one downward horizon sightline form a small glowing angle, no symbols or numbers.
shots.action: A glowing arc appears between the horizontal ray and the horizon sightline.
shots.mood: Precise and approachable, clean luminous geometry.

shots.narration: [excited] اونچائی اور افق کے زاویے سے زمین کا سائز نکالا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, simplified unlabelled Earth cross-section with an exaggerated mountain, summit sightline tangent to the curved surface, and triangle joining Earth's centre, summit and horizon; no writing.
shots.action: Noori illuminates the triangle connecting Earth's centre, the summit and the horizon.
shots.mood: Satisfying scientific insight, glowing gold against deep blue.

shots.narration: ان کا جواب اصل قدر کے بہت قریب تھا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm library with two unlabelled translucent Earth spheres side by side, one estimated and one reference, almost identical in size, no text.
shots.action: Noori slides the two spheres together until their outlines nearly overlap.
shots.mood: Rewarding discovery, cheerful blue and amber glow.

shots.narration: حمزہ سمجھ گیا، چھوٹی پیمائش سے بڑی بات کھل سکتی ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cozy library table holding a small mountain model beside an unlabelled globe, blank notebook in Hamza's hand, no writing anywhere.
shots.action: Hamza places the mountain model beside the globe.

shots.narration: [whispers] اندھیرے کمرے میں باہر کا منظر کیسے دکھ سکتا ہے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, dark workshop with a tiny opening in a shutter and a faint inverted image of an outdoor tree on the opposite wall, no text.
shots.action: Hamza points at the upside-down tree image on the wall.
shots.mood: Gentle mystery, soft lantern glow and a narrow beam of daylight.

episode.endHook: Andhere kamre mein bahar ka manzar kaise nazar aa sakta hai?
episode.description: حمزہ اور نوری کے ساتھ دیکھیے کہ البیرونی نے پہاڑ، افق اور جیومیٹری سے زمین کے سائز کا اندازہ کیسے لگایا۔ ان کا جواب اصل قدر کے بہت قریب تھا!
